sql_injection_risk.details: No raw SQL string construction found in any modified Go file. All database access uses pgx parameterized queries. The loader.go changes add FCF/revenue series loading and parameter set resolution, but all queries use pgx with parameterized inputs (ticker, security ID, etc.). No ticker/param interpolation into SQL.

numeric_safety.details: All numeric operations go through the `sane()` guard (checks NaN/Inf, optional positivity) and `isFinite()` function. The new code in plausibility.go, shareclass.go, fcfnorm.go, and growthsignals.go all validate inputs before use. No unguarded NaN/Inf can reach API output.

reason_confidence_logic.details: C1 (plausibility): checkPlausibility enforces P/E < 1, MOS > 95%, FCF yield > 100%, intrinsic > 20×price with nil-safe short-circuit. C2 (share class): NormalizeShareClass uses hardcoded 1500 ratio with BRK-B detection, scalePtr returns nil on non-finite output. C3 (FCF normalisation): normalizeFCF pairs series by PeriodEnd, computes median margin, only applies when current < 0.5×median, guards against non-positive FCF/revenue, non-finite median, and current margin >= 0.5×median. C4 (growth signals diverge): growthSignalsDiverge checks opposite signs with >20pp gap, returns false for nil/zero rates. All logic is deterministic and nil-safe.

migration_idempotency.details: migrations/020_add_fcf_normalization_to_parameter_sets.sql uses `ALTER TABLE parameter_sets ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fcf_normalization BOOLEAN;` which is fully idempotent. Can be applied repeatedly on fresh or partially migrated databases. Column is NULLABLE on purpose with NO default; NULL means "not set" (precedence: column > JSONB key > code default true). No data loss risk.
